en.title: UK Learning-Disability Nursing Crisis Highlights Global Accessibility Workforce Gaps
en.summary: The UK’s learning-disability nursing workforce has dropped one‑third since 2009, prompting a union warning of an absolute crisis affecting 1.5 million people. Meanwhile, openSUSE’s Agama 22 installer brings usability and accessibility upgrades, and a research video explains transit accessibility in practice. Los Angeles Metro adds World Cup‑focused accessibility features, while Fort Collins debates historic organ removal alongside venue accessibility improvements.

zh-TW.title: 英國學習障礙護理危機凸顯全球無障礙人力缺口
zh-TW.summary: 英國皇家護理學院指出，自2009年以來學習障礙專科護士減少三分之一，導致150萬學習障礙者無法獲得公平照護，工會警告為絕對危機。同時，openSUSE 的 Agama 22 安裝程式提升可用性與無障礙支援，洛杉磯都會為世界盃增設觸覺鋪裝、聲音廣播等無障礙設施。此外，研究影片解說交通無障礙實際應用，而堡壘委員會討論移除 Casavant 管風琴時亦考慮場地無障礙改善。
